Who we are

Dargie Entertainment

Bring your vision to life with Dargie Entertainment, Australia’s premier powerhouse for world-class theatrical creation and live event production!

From concept to creation, Dargie Entertainment builds unforgettable live experiences from the ground up. Known for masterminding hit national touring spectacles like The Golden Hour Cabaret and Larger Than Life, our award-winning creative team specializes in full scale production management, bespoke choreography, custom costuming, and elite talent casting. Whether you are looking to launch a touring theatrical show, elevate a corporate gala, or install a high energy residency, Dargie Entertainment delivers breathtaking, custom built entertainment that captivates audiences worldwide.
